title: Multi-tenant embedded analytics on ClickHouse with signed tokens
outcome: Embed tenant-scoped ClickHouse analytics in your product: your server mints a short-lived token, hypequery enforces the tenant on every query.

env.name: HYPEQUERY_AUTH_SECRET
env.description: HS256 secret shared by the token issuer and the verifier. The demo has an insecure default; set your own.

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD
env.description: ClickHouse password (default: hypequery, the seed's password)

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE
env.description: Database holding the seed tables (default hypequery_examples)

exampleRequest: TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/api/analytics/token -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"email":"ada@quartz.example"}' | jq -r .token) && curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/api/analytics/datasets/events/query -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"measures":["events","uniqueUsers"]}'
